Adding recommended topology and autoscale policy (technical summary):

- Pool topology (initial):
  * us-west-primary: 8 x A100-80GB (baseline)
  * eu-west-standby: 2 x A100-80GB (warm cache only)
  * burst headroom: capacity to scale additional nodes (up to +14 GPUs in us-west) via reserved burst pool tied to account commit.

- Autoscale triggers (suggested):
  * Scale up threshold: running queue > 25 concurrent pending tokens or average GPU utilization > 72% for 60s.
  * Scale down: utilization < 35% sustained for 15 minutes.
  * Pre-warm rule: if scheduled job or calendar event indicates >1.5x baseline expected traffic, pre-warm up to 50% of expected increment 5 minutes before window.

- Cache & cold-start mitigation:
  * Replicate prefix KV cache from us-west to eu-west asynchronously; on failover, route to eu-west cache first while spinning up extra capacity. Expect ~60–75% warm-hit rate if we pre-warm top 50% of active keys.
  * Recommend enabling int8 quantized variant for long-tail inference to reduce GPU memory footprint during bursts; keep full-precision model for p99-sensitive routes.

- Network & routing notes:
  * Graceful failover: weighted routing with 90/10 split during staged cutover; full cutover only after health-check pass.

I've attached a quick pool topology diagram. If SummitCare expects heavy weekend spikes, we can raise burst ceilings but will need a brief procurement addendum for committed burst capacity.

Attachment: pool-topology-diagram.png
